abstract.textEnglish: Hyperspectral images and optical signatures acquired by NASA's Airborne Visible/Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS) from multiple locations are examined. The spectral responses obtained are used to promote the development of physics-based models for these signatures with future application in improvements in hyperspectral sensing.
